ort.gouhbus: Dr. Dr. Professor Dr. Dr. GOOUHBUS
ort.geschlossen: Closed. Says so on the sign.
ort.nur_samstag: Saturdays only, 8 am to 2 pm. The market sleeps in.

fahren.zu_muede: Gooby is too tired… Call a taxi via IGohbie!
fahren.beinahe_hupe: HOOONK! The other Gooby waves. Probably in a friendly way.

pow.kamera_text: A real camera. Unlocks photo mode — from then on you can snap a picture wherever you stand.
pow.kamera_hast_du: You already have it. Bam nods approvingly.
pow.kamera_gekauft: Camera bought! The camera app is waiting in your IGohbie.
pow.angebote_neu: Three of them. New in {stunden} h.

post.paket_text: Mrs. Slip sets aside a parcel for Gooby every day. Pick it up once a day — better safe than sorry.
post.paket_geholt: Already picked up today — a new one arrives tomorrow.
post.archiv_leer: No postcards yet. Gooby has to travel first.
post.archiv_zahl: {n} postcards in the box. All with dog-eared corners.

autohaus.gekauft_toast: Congratulations! The key is already jingling in your pocket.

baumarkt.werkstatt: Blueprints are unlocked in the workshop — here you only get the paper.
baumarkt.bauplan_toast: Blueprint rolled up. The workshop knows it now.

markt.schild_text: Saturdays, 8 am to 2 pm. We pay 15 % more than the compost bin.
markt.erstes_mal: But careful: the market is small. Every item you sell pushes the price down a little — down to half at most. Next week it pays full price again.
markt.nichts_dabei: Your basket is empty. Come back when something is ripe in the garden!
markt.gedrueckt: pushed down, full would be {voll} ᴳ
markt.verkauft: Sold {n} — {coins} coins jingle into your pocket.

confirm.warnung: ⚠️ Gooby will be gone for {tage} days! His stats are frozen — the resort takes care of everything. Don't forget to pick him up!
confirm.taxi_hinweis: The taxi takes a few minutes — we'll let you know when it arrives.

taxi.bestellt: Taxi called! It's on its way.
taxi.gerufen: 🚕 Your taxi is on its way…
taxi.da: 🚕 Your taxi is at the door!
taxi.verpasst: The taxi drove off… (5 coin fee). The driver sends regards. Literally: 'regards'.
taxi.notif_da: 🚕 Your taxi is at the door!

weg.rest: About {tage} more sleeps and he's back!

abholen.titel: Gooby is waiting at the airport!
abholen.overdue: He took a taxi himself — that costs 60 coins.
abholen.fertig: Reunited! Gooby brings {coins} souvenir coins & postcards!

cutscene.karte_1: Gooby drags the trolley case out the back door…
cutscene.karte_2: One last wave in the driveway.
cutscene.karte_3: The taxi is already waiting at the curb.
cutscene.karte_5: And off into the clouds! Safe travels, Gooby! ✈
cutscene.karte_rueckkehr: Gooby is back — with a bag, a suitcase and a giant grin!

gooberando.unterwegs: 🍜 Your food is on its way…
gooberando.klingel: DING DONG! The delivery Gooby is here!
gooberando.uebergeben: Here you go, still warm! Bow included.
gooberando.bestellt: Order placed! The kitchen is goobying already.
gooberando.abgestellt: The bag was left at the door. Note: "I rang! – G."
gooberando.buff: Extra grin 😁 — Gooby tires more slowly for 2 hours!
gooberando.notif_da: 🍜 Your food is here! DING DONG
